title: Peasant protests and Bengai Jote firing
detail: Corrado describes peasant protests in the Naxalbari area during February–May and dates police firing at Bengai Jote to 25 May. Her account of the preceding events partly draws on Sanjay Mitra’s oral testimony; this entry gives no casualty figure.

title: Naxalbari solidarity committee formed
detail: Corrado dates the formation of the Naxalbari and Peasant Struggle Solidarity Committee to July–August 1967.

title: Revolutionary coordination committee formed
detail: Corrado says the committee became the All India Coordination Committee of Communist Revolutionaries in November 1967.

title: CPI(ML) formation announced
detail: Corrado describes revolutionary circles around Charu Mazumdar approving formation of the CPI(ML) in 1969; Das dates the announcement to May.
